items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Like Richard or Ernest McLean and so forth. They lived just a little, if I can remember they lived in the Six Ward on the other side of Esplanade Street.

ctx.x: Didn't the McLeans live in that? Like Richard?
Like Richard or Ernest McLean and so forth. They lived just a little, if I can remember they lived in the Six Ward on the other side of Esplanade Street.
And did Harold Deshawn live in that neighborhood?
